transcript.text: I reviewed the signed artist license this morning and confirmed three key constraints: Signal Garden may be presented only as ticketed sessions — not walk-up admission. The festival may not record the installation — so the draft's promotional recording policy conflicts with the license. And the artist credit in all visitor materials must read exactly 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor.' These all conflict with the current draft plan, which proposes walk-up admission and festival recording.
